title: Nonvolatile Sequential Logic Enabled by CuInP
abstract: Nonvolatile flip-flops and latches have been proposed as key building blocks for improving the reliability and energy efficiency of computing systems operating under aggressive power gating and intermittent power availability. Ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) based on van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures provide a promising approach for nonvolatile sequential logic by enabling direct integration of memory functionality into logic devices while minimizing interface-related degradation.
